name: Binangonan
discoverySummary: A local municipal cadastral/assessment custodian is evidenced, and Geoportal Philippines exposes an LMB Parcel data catalog entry. Anonymous public vector retrieval was not verified.
queryOutcomes: English and Filipino/Tagalog discovery queries are recorded in the city packet. First-party municipal and national portal URLs were retained; no third-party parcel geometry was used.
requestOutcomes: The municipal map GET returned 403. Geoportal catalog GETs returned 200 and exposed denr_parcel_data. WMS/WFS capability requests timed out with HTTP 000. These outcomes do not establish absence.
schemaCrsAndIdentity: Not established: capability and feature responses were unavailable. No native fields, IDs, CRS, or composite-key provenance are claimed.
safeFieldAllowlist: full native Polygon or MultiPolygon geometry
registryQualification: Qualified only for local custodian/procedure evidence; not qualified for open parcel geometry or runtime adapter admission.
uncertainty: The official municipal map was blocked to direct retrieval and may not be cadastral. The national catalog's Parcel data layer may have restricted, tiled-only, generalized, or non-citywide access. No exact-point query was treated as dispositive.
reviewDecision: Hold for serial review; do not integrate or enable runtime source. Future attempt should inspect the official viewer with ordinary anonymous requests only, obtain a bounded feature response, confirm CRS and a stable safe native ID, and retain no more than three polygons.
